📖 How to use

  1. Enter dice X, sides Y, modifier and target.
  2. Press Compute.
  3. Read the success chance and the full distribution table.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is the distribution computed?

Dynamic programming convolves one die at a time — exact counts for every total, no Monte Carlo sampling.

What does P(≥) mean?

The cumulative chance of rolling at least that total — the number that matters for attack rolls and saving throws.

Why is the mean X×(Y+1)/2?

One die averages (Y+1)/2; X independent dice add their means, then the modifier shifts everything.
